audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s and basic attacks reduce it; Meditate is a flat 10s; Wuju Style 14s; Highlander 85s. Those numbers are what tell the player when the free lane is actually free.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup is absent: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to ALL slowing effects. The page tells you to keep the slow on him without ever saying why it stops working. Meditate's channel and Alpha Strike's untargetability are also unmentioned.
audit.why: Riot's R text says he is immune to slowing effects while Highlander is active — Infected Bonesaw is Mundo's only kiting tool and it does nothing for those seconds. Meditate is a 10s channel that heals and reduces damage taken; a channel breaks to CC, but Dr. Mundo's kit contains no stun, root or knock-up at all, so he cannot interrupt it and Grievous Wounds is the only answer. Alpha Strike makes him untargetable mid-dash, and his own basic attacks shorten its cooldown.
audit.corrected: State the slow immunity, state that you have no CC to break Meditate so anti-heal is mandatory, and note the untargetable Alpha Strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite Meditate being his sustain engine.
audit.why: Meditate restores health on a flat 10s cooldown and Mundo has no interrupt; Grievous Wounds applied before he channels is the whole counterplay.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal called for in the late spike.
